2609.11677.title: Ecdysis: Efficient and Effective Training of Runtime Harnesses for LLM Agents
2609.11677.paper_summary: Self-evolving runtime harnesses can substantially improve the capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents and provide a promising paradigm for optimizing agent execution. Existing harness evolution methods typically rely on iterative search, repeatedly evaluating and revising candidate harnesses based on execution feedback from task instances. While this paradigm enables continuous harness optimization, it incurs substantial time overhead due to repeated agent executions and code modifications, and may overfit to observed tasks and specific failure patterns, resulting in degraded generalization to unseen tasks. We identify the lack of principled failure diagnosis as a key bottleneck in harness evolution: an observed failure can reflect either model-specific deficiencies or systematic harness deficiencies, and directly optimizing against individual failures can lead to unnecessary model-specific accommodation. We therefore propose Ecdysis, an efficient and effective framework that distinguishes model-specific accommodation from harness-level repair and biases adaptation toward systematic harness deficiencies by identifying recurring cross-task failure patterns. Ecdysis adopts a batch-level cross-instance failure aggregation paradigm to jointly analyze failure evidence from multiple task instances and further introduces Failure-Driven Collaborative Refinement to diagnose failure causes and iteratively refine harness modification specifications. By combining cross-instance failure analysis with multi-role diagnosis, Ecdysis enables more effective harness evolution with lower training time. Experiments show that Ecdysis achieves up to a 1.84x speedup in harness training compared with existing harness evolution methods, while improving the reasoning accuracy of the resulting harnesses by 18.56%.
2609.11677.paper_summary_zh: 自我演化的運行時工具可以顯著提升大型語言模型（LLM）代理的能力，並為優化代理執行提供了一個有前景的範式。現有的工具演化方法通常依賴於迭代搜索，根據任務實例的執行反饋反覆評估和修訂候選工具。雖然這一範式使得工具的持續優化成為可能，但由於重複的代理執行和代碼修改，會產生相當大的時間開銷，並且可能會對觀察到的任務和特定的失敗模式過擬合，導致對未見任務的泛化能力下降。我們認為缺乏原則性的失敗診斷是工具演化中的一個關鍵瓶頸：觀察到的失敗可能反映模型特定的缺陷或系統性工具缺陷，直接針對個別失敗進行優化可能導致不必要的模型特定調整。因此，我們提出了Ecdysis，一個高效且有效的框架，通過識別重複的跨任務失敗模式，將模型特定的調整與工具層級的修復區分開，並將適應性偏向於系統性工具缺陷。Ecdysis採用批次級別的跨實例失敗聚合範式，聯合分析多個任務實例的失敗證據，並進一步引入失敗驅動的協作精煉以診斷失敗原因並迭代改進工具修改規範。通過將跨實例失敗分析與多角色診斷相結合，Ecdysis使得工具演化更加有效，並降低訓練時間。實驗表明，與現有的工具演化方法相比，Ecdysis在工具訓練中實現了高達1.84倍的加速，同時提高了所生成工具的推理準確率18.56%。
